title: SuperSport 950 S
description: Representing Ducati's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Ducati SuperSport 950 S is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. A 50cc powerplant pumps out 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
